added: Calls in the record event (epsilon_cad:server:record kind call): created, closed or cancelled and important changes (status, priority, nature, assigned units); notes and unit steps are left out
Config.General.license: resource name and metadata key of the license product, for servers that renamed it

Tow MDT: a simple work tablet for tow and mechanic jobs (agency type tow, config/factions/lstow.lua). Drivers see open tow requests, accept one, set the GPS and step through en route, on scene, towing and delivered
Request Tow in the MDT vehicle record for law enforcement (tow.request); a linked call gets the tow progress as notes
Tow request exports for garage and impound scripts: CreateTowRequest, UpdateTowRequest, GetTowRequest, RegisterTowProvider, plus the towUpdated and towRequested server events
SetVehicleFlag export: other resources can set the impound or stolen flag of a vehicle record
RegisterApp export: another resource can add a desktop app whose files stay in that resource
Record event for integrations: epsilon_cad:server:record { kind, action, agency, id, at, record } when reports, citations, warrants, bookings, BOLOs and tow requests change

Custom apps: server owners add their own HTML, CSS and JS apps in customapps/ without a UI build. Apps show in the desktop Start menu and open in a sandboxed window; visibility by agency, permission and computer group (customapps/apps.lua)
Custom app SDK (customapps/_sdk/cad-app.js): context, server requests through exports RegisterAppHandler, state that passes to the next desk user, notifications, window title and close
Example app (customapps/example, disabled by default) and customapps/README.md

changed: System messages (report referral, custody release) and the EMS transport call note are stored with a translation key and show in the reader's language
Citation notifications, the notice copy and the training call title follow the server language
Turkish: formal address in access and duty notifications

added: Citation payment: players list and pay their non-court citations with a command (Config.General.citations), staff mark citations paid in RMS (citation.pay), exports GetCitations / MarkCitationPaid and the epsilon_cad:server:citationPaid event
Warrant priority, court and case number on new warrants, on approval and in a Court Details editor (warrant.approve); export UpdateWarrantCourt
Report referral (report.refer): a submitted or approved report can be referred to another agency, which reads it in RMS and gets an MDT message
Hospital release to law enforcement can name the receiving agency, which gets an MDT message
SOMS Out to hospital can pick a hospital; the hospital gets an expected arrival with the custody details
Inventory bridge (ox_inventory, qb-inventory, qs-inventory) and framework money functions
changed: Citation and report lists update live for everyone who can read the record
Adding a vehicle to a report searches the server; fire and hospital staff can look up a plate without owner or flags (vehicles.lookup) or add an unlisted vehicle
fixed: Citation copies and printer pages no longer call qbx_core and ox_inventory directly
The report vehicle picker only searched demo data

added: Custom framework bridges: set bridge.framework to any folder name under bridge/framework/; a custom bridge can build on a bundled one (lib.load('bridge.framework.qbx.server')) and change only what differs
removed: The separate server adapter layer (bridge.adapter and shared/adapter.lua); job to faction mapping stays in config/factions

added: Vehicle papers: VIN, model year, registration and insurance are read from a papers resource (Config.General.vehiclePapers.resource, exports GetPapersMany / FindByVin) or an adapter hook (GetVehiclePapers / FindVehicleByVin)
Vehicle search by VIN and the paper issue filter now work on the server
changed: The server adapter is selected in config/general.lua (bridge.adapter) instead of a convar; a missing adapter folder prints a warning instead of stopping the resource
Unregistered and Uninsured flags only appear when the registration or insurance is not valid

added: EMS patient transport from the fire MDT: pick the hospital, ETA, acuity and report; the hospital's CareBoard gets it live in Expected Arrivals, the call gets a note and the unit goes to Transporting
Fire unit statuses: In quarters, Responding, Transporting and At hospital (transport statuses can be set during a call)
changed: Call visibility: 'leo' calls reach LEO agencies only, 'fire' and 'ems' calls reach fire agencies, and a Fire/EMS or Police request makes the call visible to that service
The fire MDT no longer opens person, vehicle, citation, BOLO and warrant screens and hides their counters
Hospital registration clerks can search state records by default (persons.search)
fixed: A Fire/EMS request on a police call never reached the fire MDT
EMS call list rows now open the call
StationDesk open calls stayed empty until a live update arrived
Registering a patient from state records created a second MRN for a known patient

added: Lodestar CAD: dispatch notes on the incident panel (cad.note) and Close / Cancel call with confirmation (cad.close)
Unit location and radio channel: units send their street, cross street and zone; the channel is read from epsilon_radio_advanced or pma-voice
fixed: Citation codes in game came from the bundled sample file; they now come from config/citations.lua
Call history showed the viewing officer as every involved officer; officers are now saved with the call when a unit is assigned
Linking a call to a report did not add the call's vehicles in game
Call notes had no length or count limit

added: Server adapters: bridge/<name>/ selected with 'setr aetech_cad_adapter <name>' can map jobs to factions and override only the bridge functions a server needs
Displayed person number: bridges can show a state ID other than citizenid on every screen and search by it (records stay keyed by citizenid)
epsilon_license integration: licence number, class, expiry and photo are read from the epsilon_license record when that resource runs
Dispatch seat and Dispatcher role (Config.General.dispatch.mode): dispatch powers come from a dispatch seat computer or the shift role instead of rank
Admin console: mark a computer as a dispatch seat
escrow_ignore keeps config, bridge, locales and install files open
changed: Assigning or detaching other units, closing calls and creating calls are desk-only; the vehicle MDT can no longer dispatch
Driver licence number shows in name search results when epsilon_license is used

added: Desk computers are saved to the database (table epsilon_cad_desk_state, created automatically)
changed: A server or resource restart no longer resets desks: files, icon positions, open windows, sign-ins and the on/off/locked state are restored. Idle desks still lock after autoLockMinutes

fixed: Reopening the desk computer replayed the window open animation and reloaded every app; the screen now stays loaded and reappears instantly
Restored windows from another player no longer animate in one by one
Taskbar shortcuts and power screen keys no longer react while the desk computer is closed (for example while using the vehicle MDT)
Coming back to a desk no longer rebuilds the screen: windows, apps and sign-ins stay exactly as they were
When someone else used the desk in between, their screen appears at once instead of windows popping in one by one
Explorer folders and history were lost after leaving the desk
Reopening a desk always booted again and asked for the password; it now opens in the state it was left in
Screen saves after sign-out, shut-down or restart were rejected, so the handover could show an old screen

added: Leave desk button on the taskbar, in the Start and lock screen power menus and on the off screen
changed: ESC no longer closes the desk computer; it only closes menus, dialogs and in-app views
fixed: Closing a menu with ESC also closed the computer
Leaving the desk could lose the last second of screen changes

added: JusticeNET accounts sign in with an email address (Config.General.justicenet.emailDomain, default justicenet.sa.gov)
fixed: Admin placement: pressing E did not save the position and closed the console
Pressing ESC during boot closed the computer instead of skipping the boot
A computer left during boot booted again on every open
The release package shipped development admin data and the unused seed file

added: Desk handover: the next player finds the computer as it was left, with open windows, files, unsaved text, app pages, forms and sign-ins
Settings > Account: desk name, photo, password and wallpapers, also editable from the admin console (Lua desks included)
Shut down, restart and power-on screens with a firmware POST screen
Idle desks go to sleep and lock after Config.General.desktop.autoLockMinutes (default 10)
Download button for images, videos and PDFs imported in another player session
changed: Desk password is enforced on the server, with an attempt limit
Desk accounts are stored in data/admin/desk_accounts.json and migrated automatically
Report templates, offense codes and department resources moved to data/catalog
fixed: Admin placement did not confirm the position when pressing E
Reopening a password desk skipped the password prompt
RMS person and vehicle pages kept loading when the record could not be opened
removed: install/seed.sql is no longer applied on start, so test records are not written to the database

added: Initial release
